batchSize.label: Batch size
batchSize.description: Sets how many examples are processed simultaneously before a learning update. Higher values speed up training but require more VRAM.

learningRate.label: Learning rate multiplier
learningRate.description: Adjusts the "step size" for learning. Higher values speed up training but can cause instability if set too high.

epochs.label: Number of epochs
epochs.description: Sets how many times the model cycles through your entire dataset. More epochs improve learning but risk overfitting.

loraRank.label: Rank
loraRank.description: Sets the adapter's learning capacity. Higher values capture more complex patterns but use more memory and create larger adapter files.

loraAlpha.label: Alpha
loraAlpha.description: Controls the adaptation strength. Higher values make the model rely more heavily on your new training rather than its base knowledge.

loraDropout.label: Dropout
loraDropout.description: Prevents overfitting by randomly dropping connections during training, forcing the model to generalize to unseen prompts instead of memorizing data.
